track.name: sales
track.label: B2B Sales
track.summary: Learn the core playbook of B2B sales — prospecting, qualifying, discovery, presenting, objection handling, closing, and account management — the practical skills every sales or customer-facing role assumes.

phases.title: Sales Fundamentals & the Buyer's Journey
phases.description: Understand how modern B2B buyers research and decide, and the inbound philosophy that shapes how good salespeople sell today.

phases.title: Prospecting & Qualifying
phases.description: Fill the pipeline with the right prospects, reach them without getting ignored, and use frameworks like BANT and MEDDIC to judge what's actually worth pursuing.

phases.title: Discovery & Needs Analysis
phases.description: Run discovery calls that surface a buyer's real problems, using active listening and structured questioning like SPIN.

phases.title: Presenting & Handling Objections
phases.description: Deliver demos and pitches that connect to real value, and handle the objections that come up before a deal can close.

phases.title: Closing & Negotiation
phases.description: Move a qualified opportunity to a signed deal — closing techniques, negotiation fundamentals, and keeping a pipeline honest in a CRM.

phases.title: Account Management & Customer Success
phases.description: Turn a closed deal into a lasting account — renewals, relationship management, and growing revenue from existing customers.

topics.title: Intro to B2B Sales & the Modern Buyer's Journey
topics.description: How B2B buyers move from awareness to decision, and why most of that journey now happens before they ever talk to a salesperson.

topics.title: The Inbound Sales Methodology
topics.description: Sell in a way that matches how buyers already research and buy, instead of running a generic, one-size-fits-all pitch.

topics.title: Prospecting Fundamentals
topics.description: Build a repeatable process for finding and reaching the right prospects instead of relying on random outreach.

topics.title: Cold Outreach: Email & Cold Calling
topics.description: Write cold emails and make cold calls that earn a reply instead of getting ignored or hung up on.

topics.title: Qualification Frameworks: BANT & MEDDIC
topics.description: Use BANT and MEDDIC to judge whether an opportunity is real and worth pursuing before investing more time in it.

topics.title: Running a Discovery Call
topics.description: Structure a discovery call so it uncovers a prospect's real pain points instead of just checking boxes.

topics.title: Active Listening & Questioning Techniques
topics.description: Listen and ask questions in a way that makes prospects actually open up about what they need.

topics.title: SPIN Selling & Needs Analysis
topics.description: Use the SPIN question sequence to help a buyer connect their problem to the cost of leaving it unsolved.

topics.title: Sales Presentations & Product Demos
topics.description: Tailor a demo to what a specific buyer cares about instead of running the same generic walkthrough every time.

topics.title: Handling Objections
topics.description: Respond to price, fit, and competitor objections in a way that builds trust instead of triggering a debate.

topics.title: Value Selling & ROI Communication
topics.description: Translate your solution into the numbers a buyer's boss will actually approve.

topics.title: Closing Techniques
topics.description: Recognize buying signals and use the right closing approach to move a ready deal to a signature.

topics.title: Sales Negotiation Fundamentals
topics.description: Negotiate price and terms without giving away margin for free or damaging the relationship.

topics.title: Sales Pipeline & CRM Fundamentals
topics.description: Keep a pipeline organized in a CRM so deals move forward instead of quietly going cold.

topics.title: Account Management Fundamentals
topics.description: Manage a portfolio of existing accounts so relationships and revenue grow instead of just being maintained.

topics.title: Renewals & Customer Success
topics.description: Plan for renewal well before the contract ends by tracking account health and proving value along the way.

topics.title: Expansion Revenue & Upselling
topics.description: Grow revenue from existing customers through upsells and cross-sells that genuinely fit their needs.
